lines.text: Many learners say: He was accused for lying.
Better: He was accused of lying.
Of! He was accused of breaking the rules.

quiz.stem: He was accused ___ breaking the rules.

publish.title: Stop saying "accused for"? Say this instead
publish.value: Say "He was accused of lying", not "He was accused for lying". Accuse someone of something.
